text:
mike.releases: Heads-up — Newton Partner dedicated migration is scheduled for Tue 2025-11-18 02:00 UTC (EMEA-friendly window). Need final go/no-go and pin details. Can we confirm KMS, model pin, and rollback thresholds?
rachael.sre: I ran the preflight checklist earlier, short list: KMS rotation planned same day 03:00 UTC (conflict), telemetry alerting has the new dashboards, but we need canary slice size and failure thresholds.
mike.releases: Good catch on KMS. @tom.csm can we ask customer to delay KMS rotation by 4h? If not, we may need to schedule a staggered cutover.
tom.csm: Reached out — Newton said they can move KMS rotation +4h but only with an ops acknowledgement. I'll post the confirmation here when they reply.
deploybot: preflight: all checks started.
- infra: ok
- model compatibility: ok
- private-network: ok
- kms-status: conflict (rotation scheduled 03:00 UTC) 
- canary-policy: requires human approval

deploybot: suggested action: pin runtime to `redwood-serving:v1.8.2-dedicated` and start canary with 2% traffic (slice = tenant-slice-12) for 30 minutes.
alice.eng: Agree on pin `redwood-serving:v1.8.2-dedicated` — it includes the LRU KV-fix we tested. We'll also lower batch size to 8 for canary to reduce tail latency risk.
rachael.sre: Canary KPIs: error rate > 1% OR 95th-token-latency increase > 30% triggers automatic rollback. Also watch token-cost/unit delta > +12% as a degradation signal.
mike.releases: OK. What about fallback model variants if memory pressure spikes?
alice.eng: We have a lighter quantized variant: `redwood-model-xq-8bit:v3` available as fallback. Routing policy: if OOMs or >15% CPU GPU utilization sustained for 3m, auto-route new requests to model-xq-8bit.
omments: oliver-oncall: I can be on pager for the window. I'll create a temporary alert channel and escalate to SRE if thresholds fire.
tom.csm: Customer confirmed KMS delay +4h. They want a 1h notice before cutover and commit to being available for quick post-cutover verification.
mike.releases: Great. Final checklist before we start canary: pin image, adjust batching, set canary slice and thresholds, create incident channel, and publish release notes to customer. Who will publish notes?
tom.csm: I'll send the short set of release notes + expected user impact (approx 2 min session restart for a small subset) once we finalize the start time.
rachael.sre: I'll spin up the canary runbook and embed the KPIs and rollback steps. Canary runbook snippet: 
```
Start: deploy pinned runtime to slice tenant-slice-12 (2%)
Duration: 30m
Watch: errors, latency_p95, token_cost
Abort if: errors > 1% OR latency_p95 +30% OR new OOMs
Rollback: redeploy previous image `redwood-serving:v1.8.1` to slice and shift traffic back, notify customer, open incident.
Fallback: route to model-xq-8bit for new sessions if OOMs detected.
Post-mortem: run automated eval on 500 sample prompts.
```
mike.releases: Sounds good. @deploybot can you start canary at 2025-11-18T02:00:00Z with the pinned image and settings once I post the final ack?
deploybot: acknowledged. Awaiting manual "deploy: start" from an authorized releaser.
alice.eng: I'll be ready to monitor internal traces and push hotfix if we see regression.
rachael.sre: I'll create the ephemeral alert channel #incident-newton-migration and invite oncall + SRE.
oliver-oncall: Channel created and alerts wired to my pager.
tom.csm: Customer confirmed they will be online at +1h notice.
mike.releases: All green here. Manual ack: deploy: start — initiating canary at 2025-11-18T02:00:00Z, pinned `redwood-serving:v1.8.2-dedicated`, slice tenant-slice-12 @2%, batch_size=8, rollback KPIs as above. @oliver-oncall @alice.eng @rachael.sre please standby. :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary started: slice tenant-slice-12, 2% traffic, image redwood-serving:v1.8.2-dedicated. Monitoring hooks: metrics, traces, cost.
rachael.sre: Canary minute 15 — metrics stable so far, error rate 0.08%, p95 token latency +12% (within bounds). No OOMs.
alice.eng: Seeing a small increase in token-cost, ~6% — expected due to batching change. No runtime errors.
omments: oliver-oncall: No alerts fired.
mike.releases: If all stays green at 30m, we'll schedule the rest of the slices to ramp to 100% over the next 2h with staged gates.
deploybot: canary complete: success. No abort conditions triggered.
rachael.sre: Moving to staged rollout — step1 to 10% for 20m.
alice.eng: I'll keep batch_size=12 for 10% step to optimize throughput.
mike.releases: Thank you team. Post-rollout action items: confirm customer-side smoke tests, update runbook with observed p95 baseline, and file a short release note in the customer workspace.
tom.csm: Will do. Closing thread when notes are posted. :white_check_mark:
